test_roialignv2_vs_roialignrotated: test that ROIAlignV2 and ROIAlignRotated produce matching outputs on the same feature maps and boxes
test_roipooler_scriptability: test that an ROIPooler with ROIAlignV2 can be compiled with torch.jit.script and produces identical output
test_roipooler_no_images: test that ROIPooler returns an empty tensor with correct shape when given zero images and no ROIs
test_roipooler_jit_tracing: test that an ROIPooler wrapped in an nn.Module can be traced with torch.jit.trace and handles variable ROI counts
review_testroipooler_class: review the TestROIPooler unittest class and its methods for testing ROIAlignV2, ROIAlignRotated, scriptability, and tracing
